ir.name: pairwise_tanh_margin_weighted_combined_advantage_gap_cost_gap
ir.intuition: Fixed novelty failure by combining advantage_gap weighting with a complementary cost_gap weighting to diversify loss signal and reduce exact duplication. Both signals are combined multiplicatively to jointly modulate the hinge loss margin, differentiating the loss from previous similar ones. This encourages preference ranking based on margin adjusted for both advantage and cost differences, enhancing expressiveness and novelty while preserving the smooth tanh margin and hinge formulation.

    scaled_margin = ops.mul(alpha, margin)
    clamped_margin = ops.clamp(scaled_margin, -10.0, 10.0)
    smooth_margin = ops.tanh(clamped_margin)

    adv_factor = ops.abs(adv_gap)
    cost_factor = ops.abs(cost_gap)
    combined_factor = ops.mul(adv_factor, ops.add(cost_factor, ops.ones_like(cost_factor)))

ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    cost_gap = batch['cost_gap']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)
    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))

    margin = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    scaled_margin = ops.mul(alpha, margin)
    clamped_margin = ops.clamp(scaled_margin, -10.0, 10.0)
    smooth_margin = ops.tanh(clamped_margin)

    adv_factor = ops.abs(adv_gap)
    cost_factor = ops.abs(cost_gap)
    # Add one to cost_factor to avoid zeroing out weighting and promote combination
    combined_factor = ops.mul(adv_factor, ops.add(cost_factor, ops.ones_like(cost_factor)))

    hinge = ops.relu(ops.sub(ops.ones_like(smooth_margin), smooth_margin))
    loss = ops.mul(hinge, combined_factor)
    if weight is not None:
        loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    return ops.mean(loss)
